error_budget_policy.action: freeze deployments and interventions; restore service before feature work

slos.indicator: server duration for non-streaming API routes
slos.target: p95 <= 750 ms and p99 <= 1500 ms over 30 days

slos.indicator: time from controlled dependency recovery to healthy probe

alerts.action: page; stop rollout; follow instance/database/Redis runbook
open incident; freeze releases; identify top failing route
inspect route-level duration and dependency health; reduce load if needed
follow database runbook and block writes until consistency is verified
follow Redis/queue runbook; preserve idempotency and inspect pending entries
disable online inference; keep unknown/no_observable fallback; follow model runbook

alerts.condition: raw media, direct identifier, or secret detected in telemetry
alerts.action: stop affected telemetry, restrict artifact, rotate exposed secret if applicable, follow privacy runbook

alerts.condition: scheduled restoration or integrity verification fails
alerts.action: treat backup as unusable; preserve evidence and create a new validated backup
